profile.headline: Software Engineer at Teledyne Qioptiq
profile.summary:
Experienced Software Engineer with a demonstrated history of working in the Industrial Manufacturing industry. Skilled in JavaScript, Node.Js, Vue.Js
C#, Databases, Web Design, and Docker. Strong engineering professional with a Bachelors of Science in Computer Science and Engineering from The University of Toledo.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Company acquisition from Excelitas to Teledyne Qioptiq

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Develop and maintain customizations for Infor ERP installation to better match the company views and process.
• Develop any in-house applications to interact with the ERP or manufacturing process data through a middleware layer or direct database customizations.
• Create .NETCore Web API to send data to VueJS web applications.
• Assist in day to day through advanced IT operations projects.
• Create custom reports using SQL Server Report Services.
• Install, upgrade and maintain Windows/Unix servers through Docker and VMWare management tools.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
• Designed and maintained internal production software suite used on production floor
• Troubleshooting of both internal and external software/hardware
• Setup new distribution centers with network and desktop resources
• Maintain and troubleshoot manufacturing facility software, hardware and network
• Software systems design, customization, coding, testing, debugging and documentation

positions.title: Desktop Engineering and Administration
positions.description:
• Packaged and deployed workstation/clinical applications using System Center Configuration Manager 2012
• Managed changes to Active Directory and Group Policies
• Managed academic and clinical VDI environments using vCenter/vSphere/View

positions.title: Press Operator
positions.description:
•	Loaded and unloaded press in timely and orderly manner
•	Practice safe working habits in industrial/manufacturing setting

positions.title: Technology Assistant (Volunteer)
positions.description: Classroom Network Specialist, Computer Build and Repair, Open Source Server Research and Development. We have a multitude of different platforms including Windows, Mac, Linux, iOS and Android.

positions.title: Assistant District Technologist
positions.description:
Set-Up Teacher and Student Workstations
Troubleshoot Teacher and Student Workstations
